name: Heimdall
description:
## About

As the name suggests Heimdall is a dashboard for all your web applications. It doesn't need to be limited to applications though, you can add links to anything you like.

Heimdall is an elegant solution to organise all your web applications. It’s dedicated to this purpose so you won’t lose your links in a sea of bookmarks.

Why not use it as your browser start page? It even has the ability to include a search bar using either Google, Bing or DuckDuckGo.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  heimdall:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/heimdall:2.8.3
    container_name: heimdall
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/config:/config
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:80
    restart: unless-stopped
